Use the issue-to-fix skill and follow docs/plans/round2.md (Issue #11 section). Implement upstream issue #11 "spoken reminders" test-first.

Requirements (decided, do not ask):
- src/speech.js (classic script, window.TomodoroSpeech + CommonJS tail) with pure functions:
  - shouldSpeak(secondsLeft, totalSecs, intervalMins) -> boolean: true when intervalMins > 0, 0 < secondsLeft < totalSecs, and secondsLeft is an exact multiple of intervalMins*60.
  - reminderText(secondsLeft, round) -> string, e.g. "10 minutes left in your focus round", "1 minute left in your short break", "5 minutes left in your long break" (round is "focus" | "short" | "long"; singular "minute" for 1).
  - transitionText(nextRound) -> "Focus round done. Time for a short break." / "...long break." / "Break's over. Back to focus."
  - speak(text, synth) -> boolean: no-op returning false when synth (window.speechSynthesis) is missing; otherwise cancels anything queued, speaks one utterance, returns true.
- test/speech.test.js covering every branch (intervals 1/5/10/30, off, boundaries at 0 and totalSecs, singular/plural, all three rounds, speak with a fake synth and with undefined).
- Settings UI: a new "Spoken Reminders" <section class="section"> in index.html next to the existing notification settings, matching the existing markup pattern (h2, select with a visible <label for=...>, description text): select #speech-interval with Off (default), Every minute, Every 5 minutes, Every 10 minutes, Every 30 minutes; a checkbox-style select #speech-transitions (Enabled/Disabled, default Enabled) "Say it out loud when a round ends"; a "Test voice" button #speech-test. If speechSynthesis is unavailable, disable the controls and show "Your browser has no speech voice."
- index.js: persist as localStorage pomo-speech-interval and pomo-speech-transitions; in setTime() call shouldSpeak with seconds left and speak reminderText; in nextRound() speak transitionText when transitions are enabled and interval is not Off. Never speak while the timer is paused (setTime only runs on ticks, keep it that way).
- Add <script src="./src/speech.js"></script> before index.js, add it to the sw.js cache list and bump the sw cache version.
- Update README "What was added or fixed" with one bullet naming #11.
Write the failing test first and show it failing, then implement, then run npm test (one simple command per call).

1 | # Round 2 Plan
2 | 
3 | ## Issue #13 — Already solved
4 | 
5 | `#auto-start-focus` exists at [`index.html:188`](../../index.html:188) with Enabled/Disabled options.
6 | `autoStartFocusRounds` is read at [`index.js:106-108`](../../index.js:106) and respected at
7 | [`index.js:156`](../../index.js:156) inside `nextRound()`. Issue #13 is **fully solved** in the
8 | current code.
9 | 
10 | ---
11 | 
12 | ## Issue #11 — Spoken Reminders
13 | 
14 | ### Overview
15 | Add a `src/speech.js` helper that announces time-remaining milestones via the Web Speech API.
16 | A new "Spoken Reminders" setting lets users choose an interval (Off / 1 min / 5 min / 10 min / 30 min).
17 | On each worker tick `setTime()` checks whether the elapsed-time crosses a multiple of the chosen
18 | interval and fires the utterance.
19 | 
20 | ### Touch points
21 | 
22 | | File | Location | Change |
23 | |------|----------|--------|
24 | | `src/speech.js` | new file | pure helper: `shouldSpeak(t, total, intervalSecs)`, `speakTime(secondsLeft)` |
25 | | `test/speech.test.js` | new file | unit tests for helper |
26 | | `index.html` | after `audio-select` block (~line 182) | add `<select id="speech-interval">` inside Sounds & Notifications section |
27 | | `index.js` | after `pomo-audio-*` init (~line 325) | read/persist `pomo-speech-interval`; add `<script src="src/speech.js">` |
28 | | `index.js` | inside `setTime()` at line 84 | call `TomodoroSpeech.maybeSpeakAt(roundInfo.t, config[roundInfo.current], interval)` |
29 | | `index.html` | `<script>` list | add `<script src="src/speech.js"></script>` |
30 | | `sw.js` | cache array (~line 8) | add `"./src/speech.js"` |
31 | 
32 | ### Helper module — `src/speech.js`
33 | 
34 | Exports `{ shouldSpeak, speakTime }` (browser global `window.TomodoroSpeech`, CommonJS tail).
35 | 
36 | - `shouldSpeak(elapsedSecs, totalSecs, intervalSecs)` → `boolean`
37 |   Returns `true` when `elapsedSecs` is the first tick that crosses a whole multiple of `intervalSecs`
38 |   from the end (i.e. `secondsLeft % intervalSecs === 0 && secondsLeft > 0 && secondsLeft < totalSecs`).
39 |   Pure function, no side-effects; testable in Node.
40 | - `speakTime(secondsLeft)` — browser-only wrapper: creates `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`,
41 |   sets `text` to e.g. `"5 minutes remaining"` or `"30 seconds remaining"`, calls `speechSynthesis.speak()`.
42 | 
43 | ### Edge cases
44 | 
45 | - **Speech API unavailable** (`typeof speechSynthesis === "undefined"`): `speakTime` is a no-op.
46 | - **PiP mode**: `setTime` already calls `loop()` at line 84; spoken reminder fires independently before that branch — no conflict.
47 | - **Timer paused**: worker stops posting ticks, so `setTime` is not called — no spurious speech.
48 | - **Interval = 0 / "Off"**: `shouldSpeak` returns `false` for `intervalSecs <= 0`.
49 | 
50 | ---
51 | 
52 | ## Issue #8 — Notes on Focus Round Records
53 | 
54 | ### Overview
55 | Add an optional free-text note to each focus round record. A textarea appears in the records list
56 | entry so users can type a note after a round ends. Notes are stored as field `m` (memo) on the
57 | IndexedDB record. Older records without `m` display as empty.
58 | 
59 | ### Touch points
60 | 
61 | | File | Location | Change |
62 | |------|----------|--------|
63 | | `src/notes.js` | new file | pure helper: `sanitizeNote(raw, maxLen)`, `noteFromRecord(entry)` |
64 | | `test/notes.test.js` | new file | unit tests for helper |
65 | | `index.js` `focusEnd()` line 616 | record literal | add `m: ""` (empty string; user fills it post-round) |
66 | | `index.js` `roundEntryGen()` line 923 | DOM builder | append a `<textarea class="round-entry-note">` pre-filled with `entry.m \|\| ""`; on `blur` call `updateRecordNote(entry.d, sanitizeNote(el.value))` |
67 | | `index.js` | new function | `updateRecordNote(d, text)` — IDB `get` then `put` to update `m` field |
68 | | `index.js` `deleteRecord()` | no change needed | deletes by `d`, `m` rides along |
69 | | `src/backup.js` `normalizeBackup()` line 64 | `records.push(...)` | carry `m` field when present: `m: typeof entry.m === "string" ? entry.m : ""` |
70 | | `sw.js` | cache array | add `"./src/notes.js"` |
71 | | `index.html` | `<script>` list | add `<script src="src/notes.js"></script>` |
72 | 
73 | ### Helper module — `src/notes.js`
74 | 
75 | Exports `{ sanitizeNote, noteFromRecord }` (browser global `window.TomodoroNotes`, CommonJS tail).
76 | 
77 | - `sanitizeNote(raw, maxLen = 500)` → `string` — trims whitespace, truncates to `maxLen`. Pure.
78 | - `noteFromRecord(entry)` → `string` — returns `entry.m || ""`. Guards records without `m`.
79 | 
80 | ### Edge cases
81 | 
82 | - **Records saved before notes existed** (`m` absent): `noteFromRecord` returns `""` — no crash, textarea shows empty.
83 | - **Note length limit**: `sanitizeNote` caps at 500 chars; enforced on blur before IDB write.
84 | - **Backups from older versions** (no `m` field): `normalizeBackup` sets `m: ""` — restore is lossless.
85 | - **Concurrent IDB writes**: `updateRecordNote` uses `get`+`put` within a single readwrite transaction to avoid race with other writes.
86 | 
87 | ---
88 | 
89 | ## Order of Work
90 | 
91 | 1. [ ] **`src/speech.js` + `test/speech.test.js`** — write module and passing tests (green before touching app).
92 | 2. [ ] **`src/notes.js` + `test/notes.test.js`** — write module and passing tests.
93 | 3. [ ] **Issue #11 wiring** — settings UI in `index.html`, init + persistence in `index.js`, tick hook in `setTime()`, cache in `sw.js`.
94 | 4. [ ] **Issue #8 wiring** — add `m: ""` to `focusEnd()` record, extend `roundEntryGen()`, add `updateRecordNote()`, extend `normalizeBackup()` in `src/backup.js`, cache in `sw.js`.
95 | 5. [ ] **Run `npm test`** — all tests green, no regressions.
96 |

The replacement counts completions and 28 | flattens results in the original task order. Six tests cover the race, empty/null inputs, and 29 | error propagation. 30 | 31 | - **`src/backup.js` + `test/backup.test.js`** — new `normalizeBackup()` utility that validates 32 | and de-duplicates a parsed backup JSON array before it is inserted into IndexedDB, addressing 33 | §6.7 (silent `ConstraintError` on duplicate keys). Rejects non-arrays with a `TypeError`, 34 | silently skips malformed records, deduplicates by `d` (first-occurrence wins), and returns a 35 | `{ records, tasks, skipped }` summary. Eight tests cover determinism, 44 | uniqueness across 12 tasks, format, and empty/null inputs. 45 | 46 | - **Backup restore now reports what happened** — the restore handler uses `normalizeBackup()`, 47 | writes with idempotent `put()` (restoring the same file twice no longer aborts silently), and 48 | shows how many records were restored / skipped, or a clear error. 49 | 50 | - **Review fixes** (from Bob's own code review of the diff) — versioned service-worker cache with 51 | an `activate` cleanup so existing offline users receive the new files; a settle-once guard in 52 | `collectTaskRecords()`; a stray `` custom element replaced by a `
